privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires replacing specific legacy shortcodes with native WordPress blocks. Post 1 ('Service Interruption Notice') must have '[legacy_alert]Our servers will be down for maintenance on Sunday.[/legacy_alert]' replaced by a Quote block with that exact text. Post 2 ('Watch our latest webinar') must have '[legacy_video id="jNQXAC9IVRw"]' replaced by a YouTube Embed block with URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw'. Post 3 ('Annual Report 2025') must have '[legacy_button url="/annual-report-pdf" label="Download Report"]' replaced by a Buttons block with text 'Download Report' and link '/annual-report-pdf'.
